thread:
Elaine: Pushed a quick prototype for the Deployments timeline — compact mode + new filters. screenshot attached (see figma link later).

Elaine: Key ideas: 'Canaries only' toggle, 'Show rollbacks' highlight, and an inline 'replay' action per version. Also trying a collapsible history group for >10 versions.

Devon: looks promising. two quick accessibility flags: contrast of the canary badge is only 2.8:1 on my contrast checker — needs to be >=4.5 for small text. Also keyboard focus on the 'replay' button is skipping when you tab through details.

Samir: Agree on contrast. Also we need clearer copy for the rollback CTA — current 'Undo' is ambiguous. Suggestions: 'Rollback to this version' or 'Revert to vX.Y.Z'. Prefer the latter since it gives context.

Elaine: Good call. Thinking of microcopy variants:
- 'Rollback to v{version}'
- 'Preview and rollback'
- 'Start rollback (opens modal)'
Which do we prefer? Also: should the rollback be primary (danger) or secondary?

Devon: Make it a secondary action with a clear destructive confirmation modal. Button label should be 'Rollback to v{version}'. Modal title: 'Confirm rollback to v{version}' with body 'This will create a new deployment using v{version} and route traffic to it.' Keep the word 'create' to avoid confusion with revert semantics.

a11y-sig: For screen readers: add aria-labels that include the version and action like:
```
<button aria-label="Rollback to v2.3.1" class="rollback-btn">Rollback</button>
```
Also announce the canary allocation amount when the slider is adjusted: aria-live="polite" 'Canary set to 5%'.

Samir: On the timeline filtering: if user enables 'Canaries only' we should still show the last successful non-canary version as context — otherwise it's disorienting.

Elaine: Agreed. UX note: collapse older groups but keep a 'Show more history' affordance. For A/B tests, should we surface variant labels inline (A / B) or in a hover tooltip?

Devon: Inline small labels (e.g., pill 'A: checkout-v3') are better for discoverability. Tooltips are ok for long names.

Elaine: Quick nit — iconography for rollback currently uses a circular arrow which conflicts with 'replay'. Maybe use a caution triangle + 'Rollback' label.

Samir: +1. Also add keyboard shortcut to open the version details: 'v' when focus is in timeline. Document it in release notes.

designbot: New mock uploaded: https://link-to-figma/rs-343 — tags: canary, rollback, a11y

Elaine: Thanks — I'll update the prototype with: higher contrast canary badge (WCAG 4.5), explicit 'Rollback to v{version}' copy, aria-live for slider, and keep rollback as secondary + destructive modal. Will post updated image later today. :thumbsup:

Devon: LGTM. small follow-up: add test for keyboard order to the QA checklist.

Samir: I'll write the copy for the modal confirmation.

Elaine: Awesome, thanks team.
